name: promptworkshop
description: Harden rough coding tasks into scoped, testable instructions before execution.

interface.longDescription: Harden rough coding tasks before implementation. PromptWorkshop adds explicit scope, constraints, failure handling, acceptance checks, and a review gate, with repo-aware workflows for larger changes. Manage the account suggestion threshold (Off, Complex, Average, or Basic) in Settings → External API. Compatible hosts may check it on ordinary coding tasks and ask before starting; host activation varies, and task text is not sent before yes.
defaultPrompt: Harden this task before I start coding
Turn this rough request into an agent-ready brief
Audit this implementation task for missing constraints

positive.prompt: Use PromptWorkshop to harden this task: fix a failing billing test without changing unrelated files.
positive.expected_behavior: Show run progress, return a scoped prompt with checks, and wait for approval before coding.

positive.prompt: Use PromptWorkshop to turn this into an agent-ready task: add resumable report exports.
positive.expected_behavior: Return a prompt with scope, failure handling, and acceptance checks for resumable exports.

positive.prompt: Use PromptWorkshop to prepare this migration: move settings to the new entitlement hook.
positive.expected_behavior: Identify migration constraints and verification steps without making repository changes.

positive.prompt: Use PromptWorkshop to prepare an API integration task with timeout and retry behavior.
positive.expected_behavior: Return a prompt covering retries, errors, tests, and clear completion criteria.

positive.description: Prepare a task for a coding agent
positive.prompt: Use PromptWorkshop to harden this coding task for Codex: add cancellation for queued jobs.
positive.expected_behavior: Return reviewable instructions for cancellation behavior and edge cases.

negative.prompt: Write a short poem about launch day.

negative.description: No consent to send task text
negative.prompt: Do not send this task to PromptWorkshop. Just list questions I should answer first.
negative.expected_behavior: Respect the instruction and do not call PromptWorkshop.

publication.release_notes: Initial public plugin for ChatGPT, Dots, and Codex. Harden coding tasks with a review step before execution.
